# GraspNet

[![CI](https://github.com/acme-robotics/graspnet/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/acme-robotics/graspnet/actions)

**GraspNet** plans dexterous grasps for `low-cost` arms. See the [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01234).

```bash
pip install graspnet
```

| Arm | Success |
|-----|---------|
| SO-100 | 91% |
